args.query: What are the clinical features of Marfan syndrome?

calls.first_sentence: Found 1 disease record for Marfan syndrome: Marfan syndrome [13].
calls.answer_head:
Found 1 disease record for Marfan syndrome: Marfan syndrome [13]. 

Clinical Features

MedGen lists these clinical features: Aortic regurgitation [1], Arachnodactyly [2], Astigmatism [3], Ectopia lentis [4], Esotropia [5], Exotropia [6], Pes planus [7], Glaucoma [8], Congestive heart failure [9] and Hypertropia [10]. While there is currently no radical treatment, early identification and treatment can effectively prolong patient life span [11]. 

Literature

Nursing implications underscore the importance of screenings, assessments, and close follow-ups to optimize the continuum of care [12].
